sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This AI Human Review Policy establishes the requirements for human oversight of artificial intelligence outputs within {system_name} operated by {org_name}. This policy applies to all AI components within the system boundary defined as {boundary} and specifically addresses the protection and validation of {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. Human Review Requirements by Risk Tier

questions.prompt: How are AI risk tiers defined for this system?
What specific conditions or risk tiers trigger a mandatory human review of AI outputs?
What is the process for conducting the human review and validating the output?

sections.body: Human review of AI outputs is mandated based on the risk tiers defined by {risk_tier_definitions}. Mandatory human review is required when {review_triggers}. The validation of these outputs shall be performed according to the following process: {review_process_desc}.
